project_type: React 18 + TypeScript SPA, Vite build, Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
build_system: Vite 5, path alias @/ → src/. No monorepo, single package.json.
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm test. 2. Run npm run build.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Never push to git.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict, no any. All moderation actions use AlertDialog.
key_patterns: Cards: rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 shadow-sm. Loading: Loader2 animate-spin. Pills: admin=bg-primary/20 text-primary, suspended=bg-red-500/15 text-red-400. AlertDialog for confirms. AppToast for messages.
directory_structure: src/pages/ src/components/admin/ src/components/ui/ src/lib/ src/hooks/ src/__tests__/
